item.text:
Implemented persistent task priorities in commit `5273c0d6359eed23e37fed4076c8acd9f8e6aab3`.

The task priority selector offers Low, Normal, and High. Existing and new tasks default to Normal; priority changes persist in SQLite, and archived projects disable priority controls.

Verification: `node --check server.js`, `node --check public/app.js`, and `git diff --check` passed. The working tree is clean.
